lints.name: auth_rls_initplan
lints.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
lints.description: Detects if calls to \`current_setting()\` and \`auth.<function>()\` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row

findings.detail: Table \`mew_private.ledgers\` has a row level security policy \`principal_boundary\` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing \`auth.<function>()\` with \`(select auth.<function>())\`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.

lints.name: unused_index
lints.title: Unused Index
lints.description: Detects if an index has never been used and may be a candidate for removal.

findings.detail: Index \`delivery_receipts_principal_job_idx\` on table \`mew_private.delivery_receipts\` has not been used
Index \`input_locks_principal_operation_idx\` on table \`mew_private.input_locks\` has not been used

limitations: Railway remains the SQLite demo; no private runtime login or real user session was exercised.
Six RLS initplan performance warnings require measured workload and a reviewed catalog-guard update; authorization policies were preserved.
New indexes are unused because no private runtime workload has run; retain foreign-key coverage.
No model activation, signing, broadcast, customer pilot or independent contract audit.
